primary_result: Linked-contour annular-current metrology and two-clock current-capacity aging design
recommended_decision: Treat as concrete diagnostic design; do not promote to new physical operation or useful conductor

key_prior_art.title: Enhancement of the Critical Current Density of YBa2Cu3Ox Superconductors under Hydrostatic Pressure
key_prior_art.important_correction: 2006 YBCO ring already demonstrated pressure-retained current-capacity memory; only 2.4 percent of baseline current density survived cold release in the cited example.

unclosed_obligations: Fabricate and cold-extract an intact pressure-written Hg-1223 annulus
Measure complete vector-field contour at the same temperature, field and age
Meet actual current target after extraction
Identify microscopic history carrier with a selective intervention or observation
Qualify reset or use independent aged first-load cohorts
Demonstrate terminal transport and system advantage if pursuing a conductor
